method: Each listed requirement has equal weight; implemented=1, partial=0.5, not implemented=0. Explicit deferrals excluded. Duplicate deliverable/acceptance rows intentionally retain their distinct source obligations; this is a traceable estimate, not a contract acceptance score. No customer or institutional acceptance has been inferred from passing tests.
sources: Request for  Funding Approval  of LuoLinguaAI Project Phase 1.txt
